name: Stinger Ward Trap
disable: DC 36 Thievery check (master) to prevent the ghostly stinger from forming or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 34).

items.name: Deadly Sting
items.text:
Trigger A creature who isn't wearing a religious symbol of Norgorber moves the trapdoor

---

Effect The trap targets the creature with Purple Worm sting (DC 30 Fortitude save save).

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 5d6 poison damage and Enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Stage 2 6d6 poison damage and enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 8d6 poison damage and enfeebled 2 (1 round)

text: A ghostly stinger appears in the air and jabs at anyone moving through the opening.
